minecraft:written_book_content.title: Containment Record 04
minecraft:written_book_content.author: Outlands Field Archive
pages: {"text":"The night crew heard footsteps crossing the ceiling. There is no upper floor on the plans."}
{"text":"Do not open the door because the knocking sounds familiar. That is how it learns which voice to use."}

minecraft:written_book_content.title: Red Sky Observation
minecraft:written_book_content.author: Outlands Field Archive
pages: {"text":"OBSERVATION: RED HORIZON\n\nThe sky changed color without a weather front. Every clock in the shrine stopped for eleven seconds."}
{"text":"Something moved between the trees while the instruments were pointed at the moon. No photograph contains the same shape twice."}

minecraft:written_book_content.title: Outpost Night Log
minecraft:written_book_content.author: Outlands Field Archive
pages: {"text":"SHIFT 19\n\nThree patrols returned. Four shadows crossed the floodlights. We stopped counting the shadows after the second night."}
{"text":"If the perimeter alarm sounds once, stay inside. If it sounds twice, do not answer the radio. If it sounds three times, the perimeter is already behind you."}

minecraft:written_book_content.title: Black Site Transfer
minecraft:written_book_content.author: Outlands Field Archive
pages: {"text":"TRANSFER ORDER\n\nThe lower rooms were not built for storage. They were built to keep the upper rooms from hearing what was moved below."}
{"text":"The manifest lists one subject. The transport log records two sets of footprints entering and none leaving."}
{"text":"Destroy this record if the lights turn on by themselves."}

minecraft:written_book_content.title: Watcher Survey
minecraft:written_book_content.author: Outlands Field Archive
pages: {"text":"SUBJECT: W-01\n\nIt did not move while we watched the ridge. When the watch changed, the ridge was empty and the prints continued toward the camp."}
{"text":"The second team saw it from closer range. It remained still until the lantern went out. No one could agree which side of the fence it had been standing on."}

minecraft:written_book_content.title: Hound Handling Notes
minecraft:written_book_content.author: Outlands Field Archive
pages: {"text":"FIELD NOTE: HOUND\n\nDo not run in a straight line. It learns the route before it reaches the first turn."}
{"text":"The chain marks stop at the ravine. The tracks on the opposite side are deeper, as if it landed without slowing down."}

minecraft:written_book_content.title: Wardened Test Log
minecraft:written_book_content.author: Outlands Field Archive
pages: {"text":"CONTAINMENT CLASS: WARDENED\n\nSmall-caliber trials produced no useful result. The subject advanced only when the warning lights failed."}
{"text":"Do not confuse its slow approach with weakness. It crossed the lower chamber after the doors had been sealed."}

minecraft:written_book_content.title: False Survivor Interview
minecraft:written_book_content.author: Outlands Field Archive
pages: {"text":"INTERVIEW: UNIDENTIFIED\n\nThe figure used the correct emergency signal and knew the names on the duty roster."}
{"text":"It stopped walking whenever the searchlight crossed it. The footprints did not stop."}

minecraft:written_book_content.title: Unbound Observation
minecraft:written_book_content.author: Outlands Field Archive
pages: {"text":"OBSERVATION: U-00\n\nThe subject did not follow the survey team. It moved between their intended destinations."}
{"text":"The map marks five sightings. The final report lists six observers. No one remembers the sixth person leaving."}
